how: each fact checked once by hand against the named independent source; scratch inputs: Portal JSON per propId, DCP PDFs in data/dcps/

zone.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) Land Zoning Map, checked 2026-10-19

height_m.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) Height of Buildings Map, checked 2026-10-19

fsr.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) Floor Space Ratio Map, checked 2026-10-19

min_lot_m2.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) Lot Size Map, checked 2026-10-19

lot_area_m2.source: lot boundary: Portal ePlanningApi/lot polygon, geodesic area (user ruling 2026-10-19: lot area = the boundary)

heritage.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) no Heritage Map layer intersects, checked 2026-10-19

flood_lep_map.source: Portal layerintersect (ePlanningApi, propId 1452238) no Flood Planning layer intersects, checked 2026-10-19

bushfire.source: RFS Bush Fire Prone Land (mapprod3 Fire/BFPL) intersect with the lot polygon: no feature

corner.source: NSW Transport Theme road segments within 12 m of the lot: GALE STREET and WATKIN STREET

strata.source: Portal lot: strata plan SP9807 (CP + lots 1-4)

setback_front_m.source: Canada Bay DCP Part E s4.2 C1 (pdf p11, E-11): 4.5 m or the Prevailing Street Setback, whichever is greater (4.5 m is a floor)

setback_side_m.source: Canada Bay DCP Part E C6 (pdf p12, E-12): 900mm single storey; 1500mm second storey

setback_rear_m.source: Canada Bay DCP Part E C9/C10 (pdf p15, E-15): 6.0 m; 9.0 m to an upper-floor living room
